messages:
riley: hi folks, onboarding question — first week here. I cloned runtime, followed the dev README, built inside the dev container but my integration test `kv_persistence_test` hangs during gpu init (no segfault). curious if this is a known dev container quirk.

riley: run output: 

riley: ```
$ ./bazel-bin/runtime/tests/kv_persistence_test --gtest_filter=KV.* --runs_per_test=1
[==========] Running 3 tests from 1 test fixture.
[----------] Global test environment set-up.
[ RUN      ] KV.PersistenceSmoke
[...hangs here for 90s...]
```

riley: `nvidia-smi` works on node, but inside the container nvml calls appear to block. `strace` shows futex wait in `nvmlDeviceGetHandleByIndex_v2`.

mika: welcome! weird — blocking NVML calls usually indicate either driver mismatch or namespace/container permissions. which base image did you use? devex has a few variants. :wave:

riley: using `redwood/dev-container:cuda12.2-dev` from the quickstart. Dockerfile shows it doesn't mount host driver libs by default.

tiago: two quick checks: 1) run with `NVML_INJECTION_DISABLED=1` (we added a test env var to skip NVML probes in CI); 2) try toggling `--gtest_filter` to run a non-gpu test to confirm test harness itself is fine.

amar: infra-bot: Created INF-501 — "devcontainer NVML blocks on nvmlDeviceGetHandleByIndex" and assigned to infra oncall. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-501 :ticket:

riley: tried env var `NVML_INJECTION_DISABLED=1` and the test proceeds past init! so NVML probe is the culprit. what's the recommended fix for local dev? I don't want to disable NVML permanently.

mika: for local dev we suggest either: 1) run the container with the driver libs mounted from the host (`-v /usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/:/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/`), or 2) use the `dev-gpu` node that infra maintains where the image is launched with proper driver mounts. if you need to iterate fast, use the env var in your local run only.

tiago: also check for leftover global singletons that call DeviceTracker in constructors; tests that link the runtime library might invoke those before the env var is read. we added a lazy-probe flag recently — search for `NVML_INJECTION_DISABLED` in repo.

riley: found it in runtime/gpu/nvml_wrapper.h — looks like the flag is read in `InitNvml()` but some tests call `DeviceTracker::global()` earlier. I'll patch my local test to call `SetEnv("NVML_INJECTION_DISABLED","1")` at top of main.

mika: if you open a PR we can review a small test fix to make tests robust for dev images. also file INF-501 will track infra-side mounting to avoid surprises for new hires. welcome aboard again! :tada:

riley: thanks — opening PR for a small test harness guard and linking the infra ticket. appreciate the help :heart:
